scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.start: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace=client && node server/dist/server.js
